article.title: The Economics of Repair Versus Replacement

paragraphs.en: When a household appliance stops working, its owner faces a deceptively complicated decision: repair the existing product or replace it with a new one. The price of a repair is visible, but the economic comparison involves more than the immediate bill. A replacement requires purchasing a new product, disposing of or recycling the old one, and sometimes learning a different system. Repair may involve diagnostic fees, waiting time, uncertain reliability, and the possibility of another breakdown. The rational choice depends on expected future costs, remaining useful life, performance, and the value of the owner's time. A low repair quote is not automatically the better deal, just as a newer product is not automatically more economical.
paragraphs.zh: 家電故障時，屋主面對看似簡單卻複雜的選擇：修理或換新。維修價格很明顯，但經濟比較不只看當下帳單。換新涉及購買、處理或回收舊品，有時還要學習新系統。維修可能有檢測費、等待時間、可靠性不確定及再次故障風險。理性選擇取決於預期未來成本、剩餘壽命、性能與時間價值。維修報價低不一定划算，新產品也不一定更經濟。
paragraphs.ja: 家電の修理か買い替えかは、目先の価格だけでは決まりません。新製品の購入費、旧製品の処分、修理の待ち時間、再故障の可能性、残りの寿命などを考える必要があります。

paragraphs.en: Economists often frame this problem using total cost of ownership. Instead of comparing a repair bill with the sticker price of a new product, consumers estimate the costs of acquiring, operating, maintaining, and eventually disposing of each option. An older refrigerator, for example, may consume more electricity than an efficient new model. Yet replacing it immediately also requires manufacturing and delivering another appliance. A washing machine may be inexpensive to repair if only a small component has failed, while a severely damaged machine could require repeated service. The relevant comparison concerns future costs from today onward. Money spent in the past is a sunk cost and should not determine the next decision.
paragraphs.zh: 經濟學常用總持有成本分析。不是只比較維修費與新品標價，而是估計取得、運作、維護及最終處理成本。例如舊冰箱可能比高效率新品耗電，但立刻換新也需要製造和運送另一台設備。洗衣機若只壞小零件，維修可能便宜；若嚴重損壞，可能需要反覆維修。重要的是從今天起的未來成本，過去花的錢是沉沒成本，不應決定下一步。
paragraphs.ja: 総保有費用では購入、運転、維持、廃棄まで比較します。古い冷蔵庫は電気代が高い場合がありますが、新製品の製造にも資源が必要です。過去に支払った費用は埋没費用であり、今後の判断を左右すべきではありません。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty complicates the calculation. A technician may estimate that a repair will restore normal operation, but cannot guarantee that unrelated parts will never fail. The owner must judge the probability and cost of future breakdowns. Warranty coverage changes this risk: a new product may include protection, while a repair may offer only a limited guarantee on the replaced component. Access to spare parts and qualified technicians matters as well. If a manufacturer stops supplying a specialized part, an otherwise functional product can become effectively impossible to maintain. This creates a form of economic dependence on the manufacturer's design and service policies.
paragraphs.zh: 不確定性讓計算更難。技師可估計維修能恢復運作，卻不能保證其他零件永不故障。屋主須判斷未來故障機率與成本。保固會改變風險：新品可能有保障，維修可能只保更換零件。備品與合格技師是否容易取得也很重要。若製造商停止供應專用零件，原本可用的產品可能實際上無法維護，造成對製造商設計及售後政策的經濟依賴。
paragraphs.ja: 修理後も別の部品が壊れる可能性があり、将来の故障確率を考慮します。保証の範囲や交換部品、技術者の確保も重要です。専用部品の供給が止まれば、製品を使い続けられなくなることがあります。

paragraphs.en: The right-to-repair debate concerns whether consumers and independent service providers should have practical access to parts, tools, diagnostic information, and repair instructions. Supporters argue that such access can increase competition, lower service prices, and extend product life. Manufacturers may respond that unrestricted access raises concerns about safety, cybersecurity, intellectual property, or the quality of unauthorized repairs. These concerns differ across products and cannot all be dismissed. A balanced policy might require reasonable access while preserving appropriate safety procedures and protection for sensitive systems. The challenge is to prevent unnecessary restrictions without encouraging unsafe or misleading service practices.
paragraphs.zh: 維修權辯論關乎消費者及獨立維修商是否能實際取得零件、工具、診斷資訊與說明。支持者認為這能增加競爭、降低維修價格並延長壽命。製造商可能指出安全、資安、智慧財產及非授權維修品質問題，這些疑慮依產品不同，不能全部忽略。平衡政策可要求合理取得資源，同時維持安全程序及敏感系統保護。挑戰是防止不必要限制，也不鼓勵不安全或誤導的維修。
paragraphs.ja: 修理する権利は、消費者や独立業者が部品、工具、診断情報を入手できるかという問題です。競争促進の利点がある一方、安全性や情報セキュリティへの配慮も必要です。

paragraphs.en: Product design determines much of the eventual repair cost. A device assembled with standard screws and modular components may be easier to open and service than one built with extensive adhesives and integrated parts. Repairability also depends on whether the manufacturer publishes documentation and supports software updates. A perfectly functional electronic device can lose usefulness when essential software or security support ends. Consumers rarely observe all these factors at purchase, creating an information problem. Repairability labels and standardized disclosures may help buyers compare products, but their scoring systems must be transparent and reflect real repair conditions rather than laboratory convenience alone.
paragraphs.zh: 產品設計決定很多維修成本。使用標準螺絲與模組化零件的裝置，可能比大量膠黏與整合零件的產品更容易拆修。維修性也取決於文件公開與軟體更新支援。電子裝置即使硬體正常，必要軟體或安全支援終止後也可能失去用途。消費者購買時難以看見所有因素，形成資訊問題。可維修性標籤與標準揭露能幫助比較，但評分必須透明且反映真實維修條件，而非只看實驗室便利性。
paragraphs.ja: 標準ねじや交換可能な部品は修理を容易にします。接着剤や一体化部品は難しくする場合があります。ソフトウェア更新の終了も寿命に影響するため、修理可能性の表示は購入時の判断材料になります。

paragraphs.en: Environmental comparisons introduce another layer of complexity. Manufacturing a new device requires raw materials, energy, transport, and packaging. Repair can avoid some of those impacts by keeping the existing product in service. However, an inefficient old appliance may consume so much additional electricity or water that replacement becomes environmentally preferable over time. The answer depends on the product, the intensity of its use, the electricity supply, and the efficiency gap between old and new models. Life-cycle assessment attempts to examine these stages together. Simplistic claims that repair is always greener or replacement is always cleaner ignore important differences among products.
paragraphs.zh: 環境比較還有另一層複雜性。製造新品需要原料、能源、運輸與包裝。維修讓舊品繼續使用，可避免部分影響。但效率低的舊設備可能耗費大量額外電力或水，長期換新反而更環保。答案取決於產品、使用強度、電力來源及新舊效率差。生命週期評估試圖一起考慮各階段。聲稱維修永遠較綠或換新永遠較乾淨，都忽略產品差異。
paragraphs.ja: 新製品の製造には資源やエネルギーが必要で、修理はその一部を避けられます。しかし古い機器の消費電力が非常に高ければ買い替えが環境面で有利になることもあります。ライフサイクル全体で比較すべきです。

paragraphs.en: Labor costs explain why repair can seem disproportionately expensive in high-income economies. Diagnosing a fault and replacing a component require skilled human time, while mass production spreads engineering and manufacturing costs across large numbers of products. A new device may therefore be relatively cheap compared with a technician's visit. This does not necessarily mean the technician is overcharging. It reflects differences in production technology and wages. Policies that reduce taxes on repairs, support vocational training, or improve access to parts might shift the calculation. Yet subsidies can create fiscal costs and should be evaluated against alternative environmental and social investments.
paragraphs.zh: 勞動成本解釋為何高所得經濟體的維修看起來特別昂貴。診斷故障與更換零件需要熟練人力，而大量生產把工程與製造成本分攤到眾多產品，因此新品相對技師到府費可能便宜。這不代表技師一定亂收費，而是生產技術與工資差異。降低維修稅負、支持職訓或改善零件取得可能改變計算，但補貼有財政成本，須與其他環境和社會投資比較。
paragraphs.ja: 修理には熟練労働が必要ですが、大量生産品は単価を下げられます。そのため新品が修理費に比べて安く見えることがあります。税制や職業訓練などの支援には効果と財政負担の両面があります。

paragraphs.en: Consumer psychology also influences the decision. People may feel reluctant to discard an object they have used for years, even when replacement is economically sensible. Others may prefer a new product because it offers updated features, a fresh appearance, or a sense of certainty. Marketing can amplify this preference by emphasizing novelty over durability. Neither emotional attachment nor a desire for improved functionality is inherently irrational: satisfaction has value. The difficulty is separating genuine benefits from impulse purchases and sunk-cost thinking. A practical decision framework makes expected costs and personal priorities explicit instead of treating every repair or replacement as a moral test.
paragraphs.zh: 消費者心理也影響決定。有些人不願丟掉使用多年的物品，即使換新較合算；有些人偏好新品功能、外觀或確定感。行銷可能強化對新奇而非耐用的重視。情感依附或想要更好功能並非天生不理性，因為滿意度也有價值。難點是區分真正效益、衝動購物與沉沒成本思維。實用決策框架應明確列出預期成本與個人優先事項，而非把每次維修或換新當成道德考驗。
paragraphs.ja: 長年使った物への愛着も、新機能を求める気持ちも価値を持ちます。ただし衝動買いや埋没費用へのこだわりとは区別する必要があります。費用と優先順位を明示して判断します。

paragraphs.en: A sensible policy framework should make repair a credible option without forcing it in every circumstance. Governments can encourage accessible parts, clear warranty terms, trustworthy repair information, and responsible recycling. Businesses can design products for maintenance and communicate realistic service costs. Consumers can compare expected remaining life, operating expenses, reliability, environmental effects, and convenience. The broader circular-economy objective is not simply to maximize the number of repairs. It is to preserve useful value while reducing unnecessary resource consumption and waste. Sometimes that means replacing a failed component; sometimes it means upgrading an inefficient product. Good decisions emerge from evidence rather than slogans.
paragraphs.zh: 合理政策應讓維修成為可信選項，但不必在所有情況強迫維修。政府可促進零件取得、清楚保固、可信維修資訊與負責任回收。企業可設計易維護產品並溝通實際服務成本。消費者可比較剩餘壽命、運轉成本、可靠性、環境影響與便利。循環經濟目標不是最大化維修次數，而是保留有用價值、減少不必要資源消耗與浪費。有時是換零件，有時是升級低效率產品。好決策來自證據而非口號。
paragraphs.ja: 政策は修理を現実的な選択肢にしつつ、すべての製品で修理を強制すべきではありません。部品へのアクセス、保証、情報、回収制度を整え、残存寿命や運転費、環境影響を比較します。循環経済の目的は修理回数ではなく、資源を有効に使うことです。

phrases.term: Compare future costs rather than sunk costs.
phrases.explanation: 比較未來成本，不要受沉沒成本影響。
